notes.title: The Highking demo is now available.
notes.content:
Demo content
You can play up to the middle of Area 2 in the full version.

You can play online multiplayer with players of the full version.

notes.title: April 9, 2025 Update
notes.content:
Added a setting for the "Fall Mitigation Feature"


By enabling this setting, you can prevent falls when attempting to operate the only hand holding onto a wall.

notes.title: March 30, 2025 Update
notes.content: A "Release Both Hands" button has been added.

notes.title: February 28, 2025: Bug Fixes Implemented
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Highking.

In this update, we've addressed some of the reported issues. The details of the fixes are as follows:

 
 Fixed the bug where slippery walls were not changing colors correctly. 
 Fixed the issue where slippery walls could not be grabbed again. 


We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. We are committed to providing an even better gaming experience with future updates. Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: February 20, 2025 - Emote Functionality Update and Fixes!
notes.content:
We have added and revised the emote functionality.


More updates are planned, so please stay tuned.
We welcome your feedback and bug reports.

notes.title: January 10, 2025 Update
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where some invisible walls could be grabbed.
Resolved a bug where players could continuously grab slippery walls.
Adjusted areas where players might potentially get stuck.

notes.title: We have finally released "Highking."
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45062660/874e4f94e0a278281b5082033a577593308c0ad5.png

We have finally released "Highking."

Throughout development, I often questioned myself, “Is this really fun?” and “Why is this climber ascending this mountain?” In pursuing answers and gradually working towards completion, the release was delayed by about six months.

To everyone who has been waiting, I sincerely apologize for the delay.

We plan to continue updating the game with bug fixes, balance adjustments, and new rules. We appreciate your support moving forward.

Progress updates will also be posted on X, so please follow us:
https://x.com/divideby_zero

And right off the bat, we’ve already implemented some bug fixes:

  Fixed an issue where the progress rate wasn’t updating correctly. 

For those who have already downloaded the game, please update to the latest version.

Thank you, and happy climbing!
